# Performance harnesses that the CI test run skips. Permanent exclusions.
#
# Combined with .github/quarantined-tests.txt by the Test step in
# .github/workflows/ci.yml and passed to surefire as -Dsurefire.excludesFile.
# The pom's own <excludes> (**/integration/*.java) still applies; these patterns
# are added to it, not substituted for it. Nothing here is skipped for a local
# `mvn -Dskip-tests=false test`, so the benchmarks stay one command away.
#
# Only whole-line comments are safe in this file: surefire skips lines starting
# with '#' but would read anything trailing a pattern as part of the pattern.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Declared benchmarks
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Driven by a main() and by the run*.sh launchers in the repository root, sized
# in millions of orders.

# KafkaOrderPerformanceTest, KafkaOrderProducer, KafkaOrderResponseConsumer, ...
**/performance/*.java

# RiskPerformanceTest, LogPerformanceTest, CustomLogPerformanceTest,
# ReusableLogPerformanceTest — main()-driven loops of 1M to 10M iterations.
**/*PerformanceTest.java

# Order book throughput harnesses; both load 1,000,000 orders per run and have
# dedicated launchers (runArrayOrderBookTest.sh, runLiquidityOrderBookTest.sh).
**/ArrayOrderBookTest.java
**/LiquidityOrderBookTest.java

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Benchmarks wearing a unit test's name
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# These are named like unit tests and run under surefire, but each one is a
# timing loop that prints elapsed milliseconds and asserts little or nothing.
# They are perf tests and belong here with the rest. Largest loop per class:
#
#   DoubleMathTest              100,000,000
#   OrderFilterEncoderTest       10,000,000
#   MessageEncoderTest            1,000,000
#   MessagePositionEncoderTest    1,000,000
#   MemoryMappedUtilTest          1,000,000
#   TickerTrieTest                1,000,000
#   OrderEncoderTest              1,000,000
#   ByteBufferTest                1,000,000
#   PositionReportTest            1,000,000
#   OrderTest                     1,000,000
#   TestKafkaPublisher            1,000,000
#   TestMessagePublisher            500,000
#   TestMessagePublisher2           500,000
#   StringPoolTest                  100,000
#   DecoderTest                     100,000
#
# Excluding them is also what makes the suite survive a CI runner. Surefire
# reuses one JVM for every class, so the garbage these loops produce accumulates
# until some later, innocent class dies of "Java heap space" — and once that
# happens com.solfini.user.UserCache is left permanently un-initialisable and
# every remaining class fails with "Could not initialize class
# com.solfini.user.UserCache". Two separate runs of this suite died exactly that
# way, in MarketDataTest and in ChartStatsTest, neither of which allocates
# anything unusual itself.

**/DoubleMathTest.java
**/OrderFilterEncoderTest.java
**/MessageEncoderTest.java
**/MessagePositionEncoderTest.java
**/MemoryMappedUtilTest.java
**/TickerTrieTest.java
**/OrderEncoderTest.java
**/ByteBufferTest.java
**/PositionReportTest.java
**/OrderTest.java
**/TestKafkaPublisher.java
**/TestMessagePublisher.java
**/TestMessagePublisher2.java
**/StringPoolTest.java
**/DecoderTest.java
